case.disposable_fixture_change: SWCSV changed from 1 to 0, matching the MP-3A shadow-equivalence fixture; no physical process setting changed

shadow_build.source_transform: Latin-1 reversible byte mapping; known Intel conditional subset resolved for Linux standalone; original CRLF line endings preserved during observer injection
shadow_build.ttutil: GNU TTUTIL rebuild from the supplied distribution, reused from MP-3 tooling

protocol.clock: Python time.perf_counter_ns around the complete process
protocol.primary_comparison: off versus on uses the same instrumented executable and changes only SWAP5_MP_MEASURE=0/1
protocol.diagnostic_comparison: base versus off checks build-layout effects but is not used as the primary observer-overhead estimate

primary_result.interpretation: The observed +0.17% paired mean is smaller than the approximately 1.56% two-standard-error noise scale. MP-5 therefore does not resolve a non-zero observer overhead on this host.

diagnostic_result.interpretation: The uninstrumented/instrumented-disabled build difference is also unresolved and demonstrates why executable layout must not be mistaken for observer cost.

limitations: shadow GNU build, not the supplied Intel B0 executable
host is not dedicated and CPU affinity was not pinned
external wall time includes process startup, shutdown and OS scheduling
observer is only the coarse top-level dynamic-call seam
no SWAP5 production TX/HY seam is measured
no B12 or MultiSWAP batch workload is measured
